Select molecule_dictionary.chembl_id, molecule_dictionary.pref_name, compound_structures.canonical_smiles, drug_indication.efo_id AS indication_curie, drug_indication.mesh_heading AS indication_label, drug_indication.max_phase_for_ind. Join molecule_dictionary with drug_indication on molecule_dictionary.molregno = drug_indication.molregno. Join compound_structures on molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno. Filter molecule_dictionary.max_phase equal to 4 and drug_indication.mesh_heading containing 'depressive disorder'. Sort by molecule_dictionary.chembl_id ascending, molecule_dictionary.pref_name ascending, compound_structures.canonical_smiles ascending, drug_indication.efo_id ascending, drug_indication.mesh_heading ascending, drug_indication.max_phase_for_ind ascending.
